question: Avocado Oil South Africa
markdown:
South Africa
produces high-quality extra virgin and cold-pressed avocado oil
from regions like Mpumalanga and Limpopo
, utilizing top-grade and lower-grade Hass avocados. Major local and bulk suppliers include
⁠African Oils
and
⁠Westfalia Fruit
, serving a growing domestic and international market.
African Oils
Industry Overview & Production
Growth:
The
⁠South Africa Avocado Oil Market Size & Share Report 2034
outlines steady market expansion driven by health-conscious consumer trends.
Farming Support:
Research and crop data are regularly updated via the
⁠Agricultural Research Council
Utilization:
Processors use excess or second/third-grade fruit to cut down agricultural waste while producing premium high-heat cooking oils and cosmetic-grade carrier oils.
specoil.co.za
Key Characteristics & Uses
High Smoke Point:
Generally reaches around 205°C to 220°C, making it safe for frying, roasting, and high-heat cooking.
Nutritional Profile:
Packed with monounsaturated fats (oleic acid), Vitamin E, and antioxidants.
Applications:
Used in culinary dressings and high-temperature cooking, as well as skincare and hair hydration.
